explicit_source_layout.review: Reviewed light/dark flattened source and alpha scans. Rows are irregular. Column cuts for sweep, guard and dust follow real gaps; strongest accepted boundary residue is the faint guard halo at x520/521 (alpha31/19). Only the one-pixel window rim is cleared. Interior glows, detached sparks, all alpha>32 pixels and declared centers remain intact.

processing.method: Explicit rectangles or exact grid extraction; common declared-center square and scale per row; accounted boundary cleanup when explicitly reviewed; Lanczos3 RGBA resampling; transparent padding; byte-copy atlas packing.
processing.arrow_orientation: Authored horizontal, pointing right; never flipped or rotated by this pipeline.

rows.anchor_policy: Explicit source centers; one radius and scale per row.
